description: Manages the structure and details of an organization's hierarchical units, such as departments, divisions, or teams.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete organizational hierarchy structure.
example_uses: Show me the entire organizational structure.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to view the full organizational structure without specific filters.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyLegacy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the legacy complete organizational hierarchy structure. This endpoint might be deprecated or for specific historical data access.
example_uses: Show me the old organizational structure.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when specifically requesting the legacy version of the organizational hierarchy, potentially for compatibility or historical analysis.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyById
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific organizational unit by ID with complete details including hierarchy information.
example_uses: Show me details for org unit ID 138
Display org unit details for ID 789
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific organizational unit details by ID.
